svg.aria-label: The journey, stage by stage. 1. Opportunity: What is worth doing first, and what should wait? See 01 Use cases. 2. Work redesign: Which tasks change, and where do people stay accountable? See 01 Case study and 07 Patterns. 3. Governance: Can we deploy this responsibly, and who needs to review it? See 03 Governance. 4. Pilot: What must a pilot prove before anything scales? See 06 Roadmap and phase gates. 5. Evaluation: Did it work, and is it safe to expand? See 09 Evals and 08 ROI. 6. Adoption: Will people trust it and use it well? See 04 Enablement.
